verdict.rationale: The product is a set of skill files you install and run on your own machine. The docs show installing it via the plugin marketplace, copying the folders into a repo's `.claude/skills/`, or pasting a single SKILL.md into any chat. Its bundled scripts are standard-library Python that never touch the network, and all outputs are written to a local `replica/` folder, so the core product runs entirely under the user's control. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement, a fully offline path (it still depends on a hosted LLM such as Claude), and independent hands-on corroboration.
